entries.text: With its boss out of the picture, the Segin Squad\nis pretty much done for.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

entries.text: Now that its boss has been taken down, the Navi\nSquad’s days are numbered.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0030_cassiopeia_04b

entries.text: With its boss no longer around, the Ruchbah\nSquad is as good as finished.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0030_cassiopeia_04c

entries.text: Now that there’s no boss to lead them, the rest\nof the Schedar Squad shouldn’t last long.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0030_cassiopeia_04d

entries.text: Without its boss, the Caph Squad should be a\nhair’s breadth from disbanding.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0030_cassiopeia_04e

entries.text: Sorry. Got caught up in my thoughts for a second.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0030_cassiopeia_06

entries.text: Now, about your reward. I’ll transfer some LP\nover to your phone, as promised.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0030_cassiopeia_08

entries.text: You earned 5,000 LP!
entries.label: team_0030_system_02

entries.text: You can now make more kinds of TMs using the\nTM Machine!
entries.label: team_0030_system_03

entries.text: I took the liberty of adding some new entries to\nthe range of TMs you can make at TM Machines.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0030_cassiopeia_09

entries.text: These new TMs should help you improve your\nPokémon’s battle capabilities even further.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0030_cassiopeia_10

entries.text:
In any case...you did some solid work out there.
So much so that you deserve an extra reward.\c
Someone from my supply unit will be there soon
to give you some materials for making TMs.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0030_cassiopeia_07

entries.text: H-hello...[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: team_0030_botan_01

entries.text: I’m Penny...from the supply unit.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0030_botan_02

entries.text: You probably don’t remember, but you got me\nout of a tight spot by the school stairs...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0030_botan_03

entries.text: I was glad to help!
entries.label: team_0030_select_01

entries.text: Did I...?
entries.label: team_0030_select_02

entries.text: Oh! So you do remember...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0030_botan_04a

entries.text: That figures. I never leave an impression\non people...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0030_botan_04b

entries.text:
But, um. I’m helping out with Operation Starfall
as part of my independent study... You know,
the Treasure Hunt.\c
I’m good with machines and hacking and stuff,
so I’ll be working behind the scenes.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0030_botan_05

entries.text: So...here you go. Your bonus reward from\nCassiopeia.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0030_botan_06

entries.text: You received lots of Pokémon [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]materials[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
entries.label: team_0030_system_04

entries.text: You should be able to make a ton of TMs\nwith those.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0030_botan_07

entries.text: And Cassiopeia said you’ll get more rewards\neach time you take out one of Team Star’s bases.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.text: Also, um...I heard all about how you had your\nPokémon charge into battle.\c\nSeems you were pretty amazing.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0030_botan_10

entries.text: With a Trainer as strong as you on our side,\nI’m sure the operation will go just fine.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.text: There’s four more squad bosses left, so, um...\ngood luck...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
